NamePT.title: NamePT
NamePT.description: Full name of the candidate as written in the CV. Returns MISSING if the CV does not state it

EmailPT.title: EmailPT
EmailPT.description: Candidate's email address as written in the CV. leave it empty if you didn't find email

PhonePT.title: PhonePT
PhonePT.description: Candidate's phone number as written in the CV. Returns MISSING if not stated.

LocationPT.title: LocationPT
LocationPT.description: City and country where the candidate is based, as stated in the CV. Returns MISSING if not stated.

CurrentTitlePT.title: CurrentTitlePT
CurrentTitlePT.description: Current or most recent job title from the CV. Returns MISSING if not stated.

TotalYearsExperiencePT.title: TotalYearsExperiencePT
TotalYearsExperiencePT.description: The total number of years of experience that the CV text itself claims, as a whole number (for example 12 for "over 12 years of experience"). Leave empty if the CV claims no number. Never calculate it: the system works out the real years from JobPeriodsPT.

JobPeriodsPT.title: JobPeriodsPT
JobPeriodsPT.description: Every job in the CV that has a written start date and end date, whatever the field of work. One entry per job as START/END, entries separated by semicolons. Dates as YYYY-MM, or YYYY when the CV gives only the year. Use Present for a current job. Example: 2018-09/2021-01; 2021-02/Present. Never guess a date: leave out jobs without written dates. Empty if no job has dates.

SkillsPT.title: SkillsPT
SkillsPT.description: Up to 15 main skills from the CV, separated by commas, maximum 250 characters.

CandidateCardPT.title: CandidateCardPT
CandidateCardPT.description: The full candidate profile as plain text, exactly as the prompt describes: the header block (NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, LOCATION, TITLE, YEARS, SKILLS) followed by the sections Top summary, Missing information, Inferred data, Conflicting details, Skills, Experience, Education and certifications, Achievements. No formatting symbols such as ## or **.
